Boston Haskell · Talk16 April 2014

Tim Braje - A Quick Introduction To Haskell

Tim Braje

Back at the beginning of 2014, the membership of Boston Haskell had recently begun to expand very rapidly. We'd gone from 20 to 60 attendees almost overnight. Consequently, A "why you should care about Haskell" talk seemed to be in order, so Tim Braje gave us all "A Quick Introduction to Haskell" on April 16th, 2014.
